fallhaven_drunk.m: No problem. No sireee! Not causing any more trouble now. I sits here outside now.

fallhaven_drunk_10.m:
Oh sweet drinks of joy. May the sssshadow be with you kid.
[Makes big eyes]

fallhaven_drunk_11.m:
[Takes a gulp of the mead]
That's good stuff!

fallhaven_drunk_12.m: Yeah, me and Unnmir had good times. Go ask him yourself, he is usually in the barn to the east of here. I wonder *burps* where that treasure went.
r: Treasure? I'm in! I'll go look for Unnmir right away.
Thank you for the story. Goodbye.

fallhaven_drunk_2.m: Wait, who are you again? Are you that guard?
r: No, I am here to give you something.

fallhaven_drunk_3_1.m: Oh, guard. I'm not causing any trouble anymore, see? I sits outside now as you says, OK?

fallhaven_drunk_3_2.m: Oh good. That guard threw me out of the tavern. If I see him again I'll show him one thing or another.

fallhaven_drunk_4.m: Drink drink drink, drink some more. Drink, drink ... Uh how did it go again?

fallhaven_drunk_5.m: Were you saying something? Where was I? Yes, so we were in this dungeon.

fallhaven_drunk_6.m: Or was it a house? I can't remember.

fallhaven_drunk_7.m: No no, it was outside! Now I remember.

fallhaven_drunk_8.m:
That's where we...

Hey, where did my mead go? Did you take it from me?

fallhaven_drunk_9_1.m: Well then give it back! Or go buy me another mead.
r: OK, I'll go buy some mead for you.
No. I don't think I should help you. Goodbye.

fallhaven_drunk_9_2.m: I must have drunk it then. Could you get me a new mead do you think?
r: OK, I'll go buy some mead for you.
No. I don't think I should help you. Goodbye.

fallhaven_drunk_potion_10.m: Is it that mead I ordered from the tavern?
r: No, it's not mead. That's the last thing that you need.

fallhaven_drunk_potion_20.m: Well, then I don't want it. Go get me some more mead from the lovely barkeeper, Bela.
r: No. I have a potion that will make you recover. Shannal's ghost has asked that you drink it. Now, here, drink it.

fallhaven_drunk_potion_30.m: Shannal? That name sounds familiar to me, yet distant to me.

fallhaven_drunk_potion_drink_nar.m: While leaning his head back, he downs the potion in one gulp...amazing.

fallhaven_drunk_remember_10.m: Now I remember; it was horrible. [weeping]
r: There...there...Shannal's ghost told me to tell you she's at peace.

fallhaven_drunk_remember_20.m: Thank you! To have passed her life at that place, kidnapped against her will, away from her husband and kids...

fallhaven_drunk_remember_30.m: Well, let me get on with life...I seem to have made a mess of myself.
r: Worry not, as restitution, Shannal made the kidnapper's descendant, Benbyr pay up. Here's {5000} gold. Keep it and yourself safe.

fallhaven_drunk_remember_40.m: Thank you! Please ask Bela to keep them safe till Rain, oh by the way, that's my name, gets over this hangover. I need new clothes. So I will take 150 gold and visit the merchant. Please give Bela the remaining {4850} gold.

fallhaven_rain_qs_140.m: Let me meet the merchant and then return. Please go meet Bela.

undertell_barricades.10: I asked Myrelis how to get the barricades to Undertell removed and he told me to meet his friend Shannal inside the beach-scene house.
undertell_barricades.20: I met Shannal and she said I had to prove myself before she would remove the barriers. She feared that I am not ready to enter Undertell.
undertell_barricades.40: Shannal gave me a special Traders' Guild bronze coin and asked me to show it to Benbyr north of Fallhaven.
undertell_barricades.60: A frightened Benbyr told me these coins were payments his ancestor received for kidnapping people to work in the mines of Undertell.
undertell_barricades.70: Benbyr asked me to help save him from Shannal.
undertell_barricades.80: Shannal told me she did not want to kill Benbyr. She wanted him to pay toward helping her descendant, the drunkard named Rain who sleeps outside the Fallhaven Tavern.
undertell_barricades.90: Shannal asked me to help cure Rain by giving him one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses and whatever I can get of value from Benbyr. But I should visit Benbyr first.
undertell_barricades.100: Benbyr offered me fifty gold to keep the matter quiet. I refused.
undertell_barricades.110: Benbyr then offered 500 gold. I still refused.
undertell_barricades.120: Benbyr became terrified and handed over 5000 gold.
undertell_barricades.130: I gave one of Lodar's Potion of Heightened Senses to drunkard outside the Fallhaven tavern, and he remembered his time in Undertell.
undertell_barricades.140: I assured Rain that Shannal was at peace and gave him the 5000 gold Benbyr had given me. He told me to keep the money safe with Bela until his hangover passed.
undertell_barricades.150: I entrusted 4850 gold to Bela for safekeeping. She agreed to hold it.
undertell_barricades.160: Shannal thanked me for helping Rain and warned me to be careful. She removed the barricades in front of the entrance to Undertell.

fallhavendrunk.10: A drunk outside Fallhaven tavern began telling me his story, but wants me to bring him some mead. I don't know if his story will lead anywhere though.
fallhavendrunk.100: The drunk told me he used to travel with Unnmir. I should go talk to Unnmir.
